scientific_question: Can an equal-budget, globally connected, directed non-orthogonal c_proj output map preserve the activation-affine gain across held-out task windows, and does train/fit task-gradient consensus improve support transfer?

identity.execution_commit_rule: record a clean pushed commit containing this immutable plan before implementation

shared_hidden_chart.feedback: zero for this one-step prospective diagnostic
shared_hidden_chart.weight_decay_application: identical production ordering in every arm

directed_map.basis: current post-hidden c_proj output rows; no FHT, learned basis, or persistent axes
directed_map.activation_residual_score: 2 beta_ij A_i^T T_j - beta_ij^2 A_i^T A_i
directed_map.joint_refit: For each target j, jointly ridge-solve its selected 16 A columns against T_j in float64 using ridge 1e-6 times mean selected diagonal Gram.
directed_map.application: Build sparse B with selected directed coefficients and apply X_new=X+X B exactly.

global_directed16_activation_task_consen.fit_validation_gradient: gradient on the fixed fit window
global_directed16_activation_task_consen.consensus: normalize each full c_proj gradient independently to unit Frobenius norm, then average with equal weight
global_directed16_activation_task_consen.single_edge_task_score: negative consensus-gradient inner product with the single-edge weight update using beta_ij
global_directed16_activation_task_consen.support_score: activation_residual_score and consensus task score are each divided by their global RMS over all directed edges, then added with unit weight

trust_constraint.definition: For each layer-phase cell, multiply all sparse B coefficients by min(1, sqrt(output32_control_output_delta_energy/raw_candidate_output_delta_energy)).
trust_constraint.invertibility_check: minimum singular value of exact full I+B must be at least 0.95

diagnostics: fit/holdout residual-stream energy and task-gradient predicted CE descent
support overlap between activation-only and consensus arms
skew, symmetric-off-diagonal, and diagonal coefficient energy
trust scale and minimum singular value of I+B
prohibited: fit or selection on holdout tokens
dense residual or dense optimizer update
more than 16 incoming coordinates per target
post-hoc score weights, ridge, trust, seed, or support-size tuning

candidate_common_pass_all: all outputs, support scores, ridge solves, exact maps, and metrics are finite
candidate uses exactly 147456 total coordinates per selected layer, equal to control
candidate exact output-delta energy is no greater than control in every layer-phase cell
minimum singular value of every exact I+B is at least 0.95
aggregate held-out residual-stream energy is no more than 0.95 times control
aggregate held-out predicted CE descent is positive, at least 1.15 times control, and at least 0.004353292856055148
candidate beats control on all four held-out finite-step CE comparisons and at least seven of all eight comparisons
mean candidate finite-step CE is at least 0.0005 lower than control and no greater than 7.180657014250755
consensus_candidate_extra_pass_all: consensus candidate beats activation-only on at least three of four held-out finite-step CE comparisons
consensus candidate mean finite-step CE is lower than activation-only
selection_order: select global_directed16_activation if it passes all common gates
otherwise select global_directed16_activation_task_consensus only if it passes all common and consensus-extra gates
otherwise reject this global directed16 family
decision_rule.pass_action: preregister only the selected production map, add exact-resume/correctness tests, and require a directly polled at-least-20-percent MFU gate before one 124M causal run
decision_rule.fail_action: reject global directed16 without causal training; use support overlap, non-orthogonal energy, and phase transfer to decide whether to test a low-dimensional state-conditioned output metric or close sparse output maps
